about:
Lectronix Inc. is headquartered in Lansing, Michigan, with satellite engineering offices in Ann Arbor and Grand Rapids. The company operates as a contract electronics manufacturer and electronic assembly provider, delivering turnkey hardware and software solutions from its U.S.-based facilities.

Its capabilities span the full product lifecycle: hardware engineering, software development, mechanical design, and prototyping under one roof, plus PCB assembly, system integration, functional testing, and comprehensive product assembly. Lectronix supports low-, mid-, and high-volume production runs, serving Tier 1, global OEM, and regional customers with scalable manufacturing solutions.

The company serves automotive, transportation, public safety, industrial automation, networking and telecommunications, robotics, and select medical applications. Notable examples include proprietary rugged Android displays and vehicle controllers built for police and public safety fleets.

Lectronix emphasizes an integrated model that aligns engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain management to reduce vendor handoffs, accelerate time-to-market, and maintain quality through design-for-manufacturability practices, rigorous validation, and continuous improvement.
